scope: CPU-only isolated H100 compilation, no GPU tests started while G4 active.
runner_source:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,fcntl,sys,datetime,hashlib
base=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
# Advisory locks alone cannot exclude unrelated users; also refuse any active
# CUDA context or G4 worker, including its gap between execution groups.
with (base/'gpu-tests.lock').open('a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 procs=subprocess.check_output(['ps','-eo','pid,args'],text=True)
 active=[line for line in procs.splitlines() if 'run_g4_campaign.py run' in line or '--g4-server' in line or '--g4-session' in line]
 gpu=subprocess.check_output(['nvidia-smi','--query-compute-apps=pid,process_name','--format=csv,noheader'],text=True).strip()
 if active or gpu:
  print(json.dumps(dict(state='busy',gpu=gpu,campaign_processes=active)))
  sys.exit(75)
 if '--check-ready' in sys.argv:
  print(json.dumps(dict(state='ready')));sys.exit(0)
 out=base/('results-'+datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'))
 out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
 exe=base/'scvx_gather_benchmark'
 metadata=dict(scope='H100 gather-kernel tests only; not complete trajectory qualification. Timings are repeated cache-resident CUDA graph replays.',sha256=hashlib.sha256(exe.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),gpu=subprocess.check_output(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=name,uuid,driver_version','--format=csv'],text=True))
 (out/'metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata,indent=2))
 cmds=[('parity',[str(exe)]),('microbenchmark',[str(exe),'measure'])]
 for tool in ['memcheck','initcheck','racecheck','synccheck']:
  cmd=['/usr/local/cuda-12.8/bin/compute-sanitizer','--tool',tool,'--error-exitcode','99']
  if tool=='memcheck':cmd+=['--leak-check','full']
  cmds.append((tool,cmd+[str(exe)]))
 for name,cmd in cmds:
  try:
   r=subprocess.run(cmd,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=300)
   report=dict(command=cmd,returncode=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout,stderr=r.stderr)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
   report=dict(command=cmd,returncode=None,timeout=True,stdout=str(e.stdout),stderr=str(e.stderr))
  (out/(name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
  if report['returncode']!=0:sys.exit(1)
 print(json.dumps(dict(state='passed',results=str(out))))
